class.name: PlayFabMultiplayer
class.brief_description: PlayFab Multiplayer lobby and matchmaking service.
class.description: Accessed through [code]PlayFab.multiplayer[/code]. All user-owned calls require a signed-in [PlayFabUser] and use that user's native entity handle. Matchmaking completion reports arranged-lobby connection strings but never auto-joins them. Failed lobby create/join completions detach their temporary [PlayFabLobby] wrapper and do not appear in [method get_lobbies]. If finishing lobby or matchmaking state changes fails, [signal multiplayer_error] is emitted and the service resets to an uninitialized state; call [method initialize_async] again before issuing more Multiplayer calls.

method.name: initialize_async
method.description: Initializes PlayFab Multiplayer after [PlayFab] is initialized.

method.name: shutdown_async
method.description: Shuts down Multiplayer resources. In-flight lobby and matchmaking operations complete with cancellation before SDK teardown begins; if shutdown is requested from a state-change handler, native teardown is deferred until the current SDK state-change batch is finished. Operation storage is retained until after [code]PFMultiplayerUninitialize()[/code], so handlers may safely call back into PlayFab without invalidating shutdown iteration.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns whether PlayFab Multiplayer is initialized.

method.name: create_lobby_async
method.description: Creates and joins a lobby for [param user].

method.name: join_lobby_async
method.description: Joins a lobby using a connection string.

method.name: join_arranged_lobby_async
method.description: Explicitly joins an arranged lobby using a connection string from a matched ticket. [param config] initializes the newly created arranged lobby's capacity, access policy, owner migration policy, and PlayFab Lobby invitation restriction. Only the first successful joiner's values initialize the lobby; later joiners do not update it. See [PlayFabLobbyJoinConfig] for defaults, validation, and the compile-time GDK edition gate on owner-only invitations. Set capacity here rather than shrinking the lobby after joining, which reopens a join race. [method join_lobby_async] ignores all arranged-only fields.

method.name: create_match_ticket_async
method.description: Creates a matchmaking ticket and resolves only after the returned [PlayFabMatchTicket] has a non-empty [member PlayFabMatchTicket.ticket_id]. [member PlayFabMatchmakingTicketConfig.members] supplies local entity handles, while [member PlayFabMatchmakingTicketConfig.members_to_match_with] supplies remote premade-group entity keys. Immediate validation failures use [code]invalid_match_ticket_config[/code] when the config or remote-member request is invalid.

method.name: join_match_ticket_async
method.description: Joins an existing matchmaking ticket by id. [param local_members] accepts the same local [PlayFabMatchmakingMember] / [PlayFabUser] entries as [member PlayFabMatchmakingTicketConfig.members]; when empty, [param user] is added with empty attributes. A successful completion means the service accepted the local users and the ticket left [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.STATUS_JOINING] for [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.STATUS_WAITING_FOR_PLAYERS], [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.STATUS_WAITING_FOR_MATCH], or [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.STATUS_MATCHED]; it does not mean a match was found. Blank [param ticket_id] or [param queue_name] values fail with [code]invalid_join_match_ticket[/code]. Failed or cancelled joins complete as errors instead of returning a success-shaped tracked ticket.

method.name: get_lobbies
method.description: Returns tracked, connected lobbies. Failed create/join attempts are removed before their failure signal completes.

method.name: get_lobby
method.description: Returns a tracked lobby by id.

method.name: get_match_tickets
method.description: Returns surfaced tracked tickets. Locally created tickets are omitted until [method create_match_ticket_async] assigns a non-empty ticket id.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Aggregate lobby and matchmaking state signal.

signal.name: invite_received
signal.description: Emitted when a lobby invite arrives.

signal.name: multiplayer_error
signal.description: Emitted for Multiplayer dispatch errors. A [code]lobby_state_finish_failed[/code] or [code]matchmaking_state_finish_failed[/code] result means the native dispatcher was reset and [method initialize_async] must succeed before further Multiplayer use.
